Attached: 1 video

Most code reviews happen too late to make a real difference.

By the time a PR is open, architectural decisions have been made, and nobody wants a rewrite.

The fix? Review the specs, test strategy, and implementation plan before the first line of code is written.

2 minds before one line of code beats fixing small details at the finish line.

🎥 Watch the full video [transcript & slides included] - https://www.infoq.com/presentations/agentic-dev-teams/

#CodeReview #SoftwareEngineering #SoftwareArchitecture #DevOps
